correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md: partition palette indices into blocks C_j=j(j+1)/2, local triangle-free j-colourings on m_j=floor(j^{j/4}) for large j by the known multicolour Ramsey lower bound. In product vertex tuples the first differing coordinate cannot produce a monochromatic triangle: three distinct coordinates induce a forbidden local monochromatic triangle, while a repeated coordinate produces a later colour block for the remaining edge. Exactly P_(j-1) e_(j,c) Q_j^2 global edges of colour (j,c), yielding density strictly below 2/P_(j-1). The sum (1/4)sum_(h<j) h log h=(1/8)j^2 log j+O(j^2) and i~j^2/2 prove the advertised exponent. First block budget a_1=2 ensures sum>1. Bounded independent K6 product check corroborates the density count. Bound on R_j(3) is an external premise; its citation should be updated because one arXiv iteration was withdrawn/superseded, although the needed weaker bound has independent support. No explicit threshold j_0 or constructive infinite tables are supplied.
